title: Compare variance and class separability
description: You inspect eigenvalues and Fisher scores for four Iris principal components.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You standardize Iris features and request four principal components. Z holds their projected coordinates.
You compute a Fisher score for each projected component using the class labels y. The output lists these separability scores alongside eigenvalues and explained variance ratios.

steps.question: Which component has the largest recorded eigenvalue and Fisher score?
steps.answer: The first component leads both lists, with the largest eigenvalue and Fisher score.

steps.description: You display separate charts for eigenvalues and Fisher scores by component index. The latter axis labels the score as separability averaged over pairs.
